text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High latency on /streaming/generate in eu-west2 - p95 4200ms (SLO 300ms), p99 10200ms, error rate +1.2% (TLS handshake timeouts). Ticket #INC-20384.

mike-oncall: ack. paging... Investigating. Any customer reports?

alina-support: we have 3 inbound tickets from Acme and BetaCorp reporting stalled streams ~20m ago.

jess-prod-sre: I see surge in tail latency on streaming nodes in eu-west2-azb. Graphs show TLS handshake spikes and retransmits. Possible NAT/egress path.

lee-network: pulling VPC flow logs and NAT metrics now. Early look: NAT gateway ephemeral port exhaustion on nat-gw-03 (eu-west2-azb), high retransmits + DNS timeouts.

sara-eng: can we fail traffic to eu-west2-azc? routing policy allows zone failover for streaming.

mike-oncall: on it. Initiating canary fallback: route 25% traffic to eu-west2-azc for streaming via rp-stream-01. Command: `curl -X POST /admin/route-change -d '{"policy":"rp-stream-01","split":"azb:75,azc:25"}'`

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rolling route change submitted by mike-oncall at 2038456905, in progress.

jess-prod-sre: After partial failover p95 down to 600ms, p99 to 1.6s, error rate dropping. Still seeing small cluster with TLS handshake timeouts ~ connection resets from nat-gw-03.

lee-network: Confirmed nat-gw-03 tcp_retransmit rate jumped, ephemeral ports near 64k; conntrack high. Short term: spin up additional egress NAT and attach.

mike-oncall: Spun up nat-gw-04; attaching now. `aws ec2 attach-nat -i nat-gw-04 --subnet azb` logs: attached 2038457022.

jess-prod-sre: After attaching nat-gw-04, p95/p99 and streaming stalls baseline back to normal (~200ms). Monitoring for 10m.

alina-support: Acme confirmed streams resumed, BetaCorp still saw one reconnect, they want incident update.

tom-cust-ops: Preparing customer-facing note: short summary + RCA in progress. ETA for update 30m.

sara-eng: Logs show TLS handshake spikes correlated with DNS backoffs to internal resolver 10.0.2.3; might be exacerbating connection churn. Recommend follow-up to scale resolver.

dave-release: Noted a routing table change last week — adding to RCA backlog.

mike-oncall: For immediate triage, mitigation complete. Handing off to jess-prod-sre for RCA and postmortem. @jess-prod-sre you're on for next 8h.

jess-prod-sre: Ack handoff. Will open postmortem doc and collect logs: flow logs, nat metrics, conntrack, tls logs, dns stats. Tentative RCA: NAT ephemeral port exhaustion + DNS resolver backoff causing retransmit storms and TLS handshake tail latency.

jess-prod-sre: logs snapshot:
```text
2024-11-02T12:15:32Z nat-gw-03 conntrack reached 61500/65535
2024-11-02T12:15:33Z tcp retransmit 342/s
2024-11-02T12:15:34Z tls handshake timeout client=10.1.5.12
```

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident postmortem at /incidents/postmortems/2038456789 within 24h.

mike-oncall: Closing alert on rotation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
